item: Windows portability legs run nightly on main in six shards, and on a dispatch that asks (R743)
summary: On every PR dispatch the three Windows legs hit their 90-minute cap and proved nothing. The cost is the disk: Defender real-time protection is already off (folder exclusions moved shard 2 only from 5,137 s to 5,012 s, #2124), and -n 4 made tests 4-6x slower (#2122). New job portability-windows: six shards (about 830 s Linux cost each), one process, 90-min cap, non-required, same hang/slow/fail reports; nightly 02:00 UTC on main or workflow_dispatch with windows: true. macOS keeps three -n 4 legs on every dispatch and weekly. Each scheduled job names its own cron. Release line: CI Windows portability checks now run nightly in six shards instead of on every pull request.
